guitar.notes: Daron Malakian is commonly seen with Gibson Les Pauls and Flying Vs; reasonably documented, medium confidence.

tone.target: tight scooped nu-metal/alt-metal crunch with wah accents and dry punch
tone.profile: tight scooped nu-metal/alt-metal crunch with wah accents and dry punch
tone.summary: A highly compressed signal chain featuring a boost/OD for attack, followed by heavy distortion, Wah filtering for accents, and an 80s-style high-gain amp model paired with a punchy 4x12 cabinet.
corrections: keep lead parts cleaner than rhythm

rig.name: System of a Down - Chop Suey! - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and tighten the rhythm playing.
Increase the percussive attack and punch for tight palm-muting.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of Comp to maintain aggressive edge while adding transient punch.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary high-gain foundation for nu-metal chugging.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is chosen to emulate modern, tight metal gain rather than vintage breakup.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required wah accents for lead/rhythmic parts.
Simulate a modern high-gain amp tone suitable for alt/nu-metal, while allowing EQ shaping.
blocks.gap: The UK 800 is the best available model to achieve aggressive, scooped tones without sounding overly vintage or clean.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary punch and definition associated with a modern metal sound.
Achieve the required scooped mid-range sound characteristic of nu-metal.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 for its ability to precisely shape and scoop the mids, which is critical for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Subtle modulation for lead parts without adding ambient wash.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is kept low/off by default to avoid 'ambient wash' as requested, but remains available for subtle texture.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal rhythmic echo for depth without sounding washed out.
blocks.gap: The settings are kept very low to respect the 'minimal delay/reverb' constraint.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space without adding excessive ambient wash.
blocks.gap: The Room setting is used for its natural, non-metallic decay character, kept at low mix levels.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the punchy, modern metal sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance definition and tightness for aggressive nu-metal chugging.
